# Tests that cannot pass on the CI runner for host reasons, not code reasons.
#
# Format: one entry per line, holding exactly a package import path, one
# space and a test path. A test path is a top-level test name, or that name
# followed by "/" and a subtest name as go test prints it, any number of
# times. Empty lines and lines whose first character is "#" are ignored. Any
# other line is an error. .github/ci/go_test_gate.py reads this file and
# documents the rules.
#
# An entry applies only to the package it names, and to exactly one test or
# subtest of it. The step "Test" skips exactly the entries and runs
# everything else. Tests run unchanged everywhere else.
#
# Every entry must still fail on the runner. The step "Listed tests still
# fail" runs exactly the entries and fails the run when one of them passes,
# skips itself or does not run. So an entry cannot outlive its reason: a
# change that makes a listed test pass on the runner, by porting it or
# otherwise, has to delete its line in the same change.
#
# Name the narrowest thing that fails. Where one subtest fails and its
# siblings pass on the runner, the entry names that subtest, so the siblings
# stay in the gate. A change that adds a test which can only pass off the
# runner adds its entry here itself.
#
# The way to shorten this list is to port a test so that it passes on a Linux
# runner without weakening it.

# Remote Alpha operator-host tests in the root package.

# The test process must run as the account named "ds". The second test also
# needs the macOS /private/tmp path for one subtest.
#
# The first two tests are listed whole on purpose, although some of their
# subtests pass on the runner. The TLS status bootstrap refuses a caller that
# is not "ds" at its first identity check, so a subtest that expects a
# refusal passes there without reaching the custody check it is named for.
# Keeping those subtests in the gate would claim a check that does not happen.
execution-substrate TestRemoteAlphaESServiceTLSStatusFailureWitnessBootstrapOwnedTerminal
execution-substrate TestRemoteAlphaESServiceTLSStatusRootLoadedStageCustody
execution-substrate TestRemoteAlphaESServiceTLSStatusStageFIFOSubstitution
execution-substrate TestRemoteAlphaOperatorRecoverySessionESTLSStatusStageFIFORefusal

# The test stages under the macOS /private/tmp path.
execution-substrate TestRemoteAlphaOperatorRecoverySessionESTLSStatusRemoteWrapperTrap

# The host needs an account named "ds" and the macOS /private/tmp path.
execution-substrate TestRemoteAlphaP0tGrammarDiagnosticBootstrapLifecycleComposition
execution-substrate TestRemoteAlphaP0tGrammarDiagnosticPriorReaderCloseSuppression
execution-substrate TestRemoteAlphaP0tGrammarDiagnosticV2VersionedBootstrap

# The checker reads the host's real modprobe configuration, which the fixture
# cannot replace. A host that already blocks algif_aead reports
# mitigated_not_fixed.
execution-substrate TestRemoteAlphaRuntimeSecurityBoundaryCVE31431UnprovedMitigationStaysVulnerable
execution-substrate TestRemoteAlphaRuntimeSecurityBoundaryCVE31431VulnerableWithoutMitigationBlocks

# The test assumes that /usr/bin and /bin hold no working systemctl.
execution-substrate TestRemoteAlphaRuntimeSecurityBoundaryCheckMissingToolsStayHonest

# es/app: a go command in the system directories of the harness PATH defeats
# the missing-Go fixture of this one subtest in each test. The runner image
# has such a go command. The three other subtests of each test stay in the
# gate.
execution-substrate/es/app TestSupportedLocalSetupExactGoPreflightBeforeMutation/local_build_path_rejects_missing_Go_before_mutation
execution-substrate/es/app TestSupportedLocalProofExactGoPreflightBeforeMutation/local_build_path_rejects_missing_Go_before_mutation

# es/admission/internal/reliablesubmit: historical-opener probes. They need
# test binaries built from older trees with an overlay kept outside this
# repository (the ES_REPLAY_*_PROBE variables).
execution-substrate/es/admission/internal/reliablesubmit TestSQLiteV4PreviousSchema3BinaryRefusesWithoutMutation
execution-substrate/es/admission/internal/reliablesubmit TestSQLiteV3OldBinaryRefusesWithoutMutation
